scope: Pinned final-envelope output protocol source audit only
findings: Successful compare report binds exact START/END file SHA plus body SHA, phase and pin_set; OK exit0, INVALIDATE exit3.
Refusal exits2 through stderr JSON and may have no compare report. Missing report cannot mean PASS; trusted refusal evidence needs its own binding.
Future final ingestion must authenticate caller-supplied root pins, enforce start/end labels and compare saved manifests using pinned semantics. It must not manufacture or rerun production END.
Journal hash chain alone cannot authenticate root finality or detect removal of an unanchored suffix. A trusted head/checkpoint is still required.
